context: A uni student coaches a teen friend through a tough decision
purpose: Teach: 見れる/愚か/味わう/気に入ら/さよう/お断り/及ん/皆さま

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、聞いてください。コンクールに誘われたんですけど、正直あの主催者が気に入らなくて…
lines.en: Senpai, listen. I got invited to a competition, but honestly I don't like the organizer...
lines.style: Hesitant teen voice, seeking guidance from older friend

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほどな。皆さまの前で歌うチャンスではあるけど、心が乗らないなら無理することもない。
lines.en: I see. It's a chance to sing in front of everyone, but if your heart isn't in it, you don't have to force yourself.
lines.style: Calm, thoughtful uni student tone with warmth in voice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 断ったら愚かな選択って思われそうで怖いんです。ネットでも見れるくらい大きい大会だし…
lines.en: I'm scared people will think it's a foolish choice if I refuse. It's a big event you can even watch online...
lines.style: Anxious, voice trembling slightly with self-doubt

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 周りの目を気にして判断するな。話が그쪽に及んでも、決めるのは自分の気持ちだ。
lines.en: Don't let other people's eyes drive your decision. Even if the talk turns that way, what decides it is your own feelings.
lines.style: Firm but kind mentoring voice, steady pace throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ…ちゃんと丁重にお断りしてもいいんでしょうか。後で後悔の味を味わうのは嫌で。
lines.en: Then... is it really okay to politely decline? I don't want to taste regret later.
lines.style: Quiet, seeking permission, slowly gaining resolve in tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: もちろん。『さようですか、今回は遠慮させてください』って素直に言えば十分だよ。
lines.en: Of course. Just say honestly, 'I see, please let me pass this time'—that's plenty.
lines.style: Encouraging, slight smile in voice, light-hearted delivery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、先輩。なんだか肩の力が抜けました。
lines.en: Thank you, senpai. I feel like a weight has lifted off my shoulders.
lines.style: Relieved exhale, sincere gratitude in soft tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 自分の声を信じろよ。チャンスはまた来るから、その時に堂々と挑めばいい。
lines.en: Trust your own voice. Opportunities will come again, and you'll face them head-on when they do.
lines.style: Confident closing line, warm older-brother energy throughout
